entities.name: Marina Vendrell
entities.description: A human warlock girl, last surviving member of the Vendrell family, whose contract with Valgavoth led to the creation of Duskmourn.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: A demon bound to the house's structure who befriended Marina and devoured her bullies, growing until he swallowed the plane as Duskmourn.

entities.name: Zimone
entities.description: A person who, with Tyvar, encountered Marina around 4564 AR and retrieved her diary.

entities.name: Tyvar
entities.description: A person who, with Zimone, encountered Marina around 4564 AR.

entities.name: Vendrell family
entities.description: The family that purchased the house; Marina is its last surviving member.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: The nightmarish plane created when the house and Valgavoth swallowed the entire plane.

entities.name: An Architectural Accounting
entities.description: A ledger of the house kept by occupants, with margin notes by Marina of spells and rituals to distort space and time.

events.summary: Sixteen-year-old Marina and her parents buy and move into the House, where she is bullied at school.
events.quote: Marina was the target of frequent bullying.

events.summary: Marina discovers the demon Valgavoth in the basement and befriends him; he teaches her demonology, necromancy and spirit-bending.
events.quote: she discovered the demon Valgavoth living in the basement

events.summary: After vicious bullying, Marina agrees to Valgavoth's offer and lures her four bullies to the basement, where he devours them.
events.quote: she watched, horrified, as the hungry entity came alive and devoured the bullies.

events.summary: Empowered, Valgavoth hunts; people around Marina die, the house warps and expands, and her parents vanish.
Marina researches and learns that previous owners bound the demon to the house, which she had unwittingly loosened.
events.quote: the entity in the basement was a demon

events.summary: Marina threatens to burn down the house, and Valgavoth agrees to give her back the world as she remembered it, while the house keeps expanding until it swallows the plane as Duskmourn.
events.quote: the entirety of the plane was swallowed up in the walls of Duskmourn.

events.summary: Around 4564 AR Zimone and Tyvar find Marina, who denies wrongdoing as the House shifts back to its nightmarish form; they retrieve her diary.
events.quote: Zimone and Tyvar managed to retrieve Marina's diary

relations.note: came to see the demon as her only friend, then turned against him
relations.quote: she came to rely on him more and more as her only friend

relations.note: she realized her friend was malevolent and confronted him
relations.quote: Marina confronted the entity and demanded it stop.
Marina is the last surviving member of the Vendrell family.

relations.note: her contract with Valgavoth led to its creation
relations.quote: whose contract with Valgavoth led to the creation of Duskmourn
